basculin-white-striped.reason: White-Striped Basculin has a distinct evolution relationship represented by the existing evolution data.

darmanitan-galar-zen.reason: The regional Zen Mode is a battle state, not another evolutionary stage.

greninja-battle-bond.reason: Battle Bond is the routed ability form; unlike Ash-Greninja, it is not itself the transformed battle state.

mimikyu-totem-busted.reason: Busted Totem Mimikyu combines a Totem variant with a battle state.

mimikyu-totem-disguised.reason: The Totem variant is not a separate evolutionary stage.

minior-blue.reason: Core color is a visual identity and not an evolutionary stage.

zygarde-10-power-construct.reason: Power Construct changes Zygarde's battle state and does not add an evolution stage.

zygarde-50-power-construct.reason: Power Construct changes Zygarde's battle state and does not add an evolution stage.
